mentions.name: Codako
mentions.description: Web-based rebuild of Stagecast Creator, a programming-by-demonstration simulation and game-building environment with a low floor and a high ceiling for creativity, designed to introduce programming fundamentals. Being user tested this fall through game-building jams in local libraries.
mentions.source_excerpt:
30 years ago I learned to program by building games in Cocoa / Stagecast Creator. I recently partnered with Dave Smith (one of the original authors + members of Apple's Advanced Research group in the 90s, and low-key the inventor of the icon) and we're rebuilding it for the web:

https://www.codako.org/

I'm user testing it this fall with game-building jams in local libraries.
